concepts.name: Batches on stability
Batches with a significant change at the accelerated condition
justifications: V20-2604 reaches 4.4% water at 3 months, exceeding the 4.0% limit; V20-2607 reaches 0.31% impurity D at 6 months, exceeding the 0.30% limit. Each breach constitutes a significant change under section 3.3.

concepts.name: Shelf life supported for the Alu/Alu blister by the rules of section 6 in months
justifications: The Alu/Alu batch shows a significant change because its accelerated impurity D reaches 0.31%, above the 0.30% limit, and no intermediate testing results are provided. Section 6.3 therefore limits its shelf life to the 12 months covered by long-term data.

concepts.name: The conclusion on V20-2607 at the accelerated condition agrees with its results
justifications: The report concludes that V20-2607 meets specification throughout and shows no significant accelerated change, but its 6-month impurity D result is 0.31%, exceeding the 0.30% limit. This qualifies as a significant change under section 3.3.

concepts.name: Date on which V20-2604 was placed at the intermediate condition
justifications: V20-2604 was placed on stability on 9 February 2026, and samples were placed at all three conditions on that same day.

concepts.name: Shelf-life limit of impurity D in %
justifications: The shelf-life specification accepts impurity D at not more than 0.30%.

concepts.name: Shelf-life limit of water content in %
justifications: The shelf-life specification accepts water content at not more than 4.0%.

concepts.name: Lower shelf-life limit of assay in %
justifications: The shelf-life assay range is 92.0 to 105.0% of the label claim, making 92.0% the lower accepted limit.

concepts.name: Total impurities of V20-2604 after 6 months at the accelerated condition in %
justifications: The accelerated-condition table for V20-2604 at 40 °C/75 % RH reports total impurities of 1.12% after 6 months.

concepts.name: Water content of V20-2604 after 12 months at the long-term condition in %
Assay of V20-2604 after 12 months at the intermediate condition in %
justifications: The intermediate-condition table for V20-2604 at 30 °C/65 % RH reports an assay of 98.1% after 12 months.

concepts.context: aspect: Results outside the shelf-life specification
